minutes.headline: Zoning board granted two special permits and continued the Wheelock Road hearing to September 11 for Board of Health paperwork.
minutes.summary: The Zoning Board of Appeals heard three cases. It granted a special permit for a second-story addition at 29 Pine Acres Road, continued the 93 Wheelock Road hearing to September 11 while awaiting Board of Health paperwork, and granted special permits for reconstructing a non-conforming house and for height relief at 380 Sunset Lane. Members said the Wheelock Road matter must be decided at the next hearing.

votes.motion: Grant the special permit for dimensional relief for a second-story addition at 29 Pine Acres Road as requested
Continue the 93 Wheelock Road hearing until September 11 at 7 o'clock
Grant the special permits for reconstruction of a non-conforming structure and height relief at 380 Sunset Lane

decisions.decision: 93 Wheelock Road hearing continued to September 11; the board indicated it would decide, or the applicant may withdraw without prejudice, at that time.
Applicant asked to bring an update on the payment agreement with the town to the next hearing.
Conservation Commission order of conditions to be treated as a condition of the Sunset Lane grant, along with compliance with all other boards.

what_happened.line: The Zoning Board of Appeals continued the 93 Wheelock Road hearing to September 11 while Board of Health paperwork is pending.
The board granted a special permit for dimensional relief for a second-story addition at 29 Pine Acres Road by voice vote, no opposition.
The board granted special permits for reconstructing a non-conforming structure and for height relief at 380 Sunset Lane, with no opposition heard.
The Conservation Commission order of conditions, and compliance with all other boards, will be treated as conditions of the Sunset Lane grant.
The applicant at Wheelock Road was asked to bring an update on a payment agreement with the town to the next hearing.

why_it_matters: Neighbors of Wheelock Road, Pine Acres Road and Sunset Lane can see which building and use changes were approved or remain undecided, and the Sunset Lane grant carries conservation conditions that govern how the work is done.
The Wheelock Road matter involves a vehicle use and an unresolved payment agreement with the town, and the board indicated it would decide the case or let the applicant withdraw at the next hearing.
